About Armadillo

One Small Crew. One Solid Shell Of Work.

Armadillo Tile and Home Repair proudly serves Greater Baltimore with tile and home repair work handled with care.

How We Work

Careful Work. Clear Communication.

From full bathroom tile to small fixes that have bugged you for years, the goal is the same: show up, work clean, and leave it solid. You can expect one crew on site, clear communication, and realistic timelines.

Every project is a little different. We take time to understand what you need, talk through the options, and give you honest pricing before work begins.

Local And Approachable

Based in Baltimore City, Armadillo focuses on Baltimore City and County while continuing to serve nearby communities, including Carroll and Howard Counties.

Respect For Your Home

Neat work areas, straightforward updates, and attention to the details that make a finished project feel right.
